description: This file defines an API endpoint using FastAPI to retrieve a list of menu items for a food ordering system. It creates a route at '/menu' that fetches menu data from a repository, constructs menu item objects, and returns them in a response model.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: Data model representing a single menu item with properties like id, name, description, price, and image URL.

classes.name: MenuListResponse
classes.description: Response model encapsulating a list of MenuItem objects for API responses.

methods.name: MenuListResponse get_menu()
methods.description: API endpoint handler that retrieves menu items from the repository, converts raw data into MenuItem instances, and returns a MenuListResponse.
